MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 25
   D. 12.5

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 31
   C. 43
   D. 41

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

7. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

9. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 5
   D. 13

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 43

11. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 14
   C. 22
   D. 28

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 2/3
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

18. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

19. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27.7

21. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 33

24. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
